research_basis.authoring_method: Original synthesis using the user brief and the THE DMI implementation reference as the structural benchmark.
research_basis.licence_handling: Original implementation content informed by Jisc structure. Jisc digital maturity materials are published under terms including CC BY-NC-SA on the main toolkit page; scenarios and practitioner language here are independently written.
notes: The source brief describes a 3-level model and requests 10 boundaries. This implementation therefore operationalises the two assessable adjacent boundaries in a 3-level model: Established to Enhanced (EM) and Enhanced to Mature (MM).
The brief also mentioned EE as a target-level code; that label is retained in metadata as an entry-threshold alias rather than a scored boundary.
